title: Continue remaining sections with retained review
changes: Provide compact, lossless shared-screen context for independent review while retaining the full audit context.
Separate historical findings from a fresh review request without changing source code or the saved candidate.
Reuse one exact independently approved saved review and continue unfinished sections without repeating completed model calls.
Offer Continue remaining sections with locked sources, fresh confirmations and explicit remaining work.
Preserve earlier failures and immutable results when appending the bounded fifth continuation record.
Keep current authority, SQLcl, import, runtime and download checks mandatory.
Recognize the sealed pre-database review stop for upgrade admission without granting retry or conversion success.
limitations: Server-side preparation must be configured and tested by the operator; a source release does not enable it.
This hosted preparation route accepts one FMB per request; MMB, OLB and PLL require the separate supported preparation route.
The focused prototype profile, current authority endpoint and private browser worker require explicit operator configuration and live checks.
Real-file OPAF-to-APEX import, authenticated runtime and downloadable export acceptance remain pending.
Any changed candidate requires its own independent review; a saved review is reusable only for the exact reconstructed candidate it approved.
Saved-proof continuation is limited to recognized sealed failures before database stages and requires operator-prepared evidence. It is not a generic retry or automatic corrective loop.
Technical identifiers are retained; redaction receipts are not complete PII certification or processing permission.
APEX generated, technical checks passed and business acceptance remain separate.
A prototype export does not prove clean-schema reimport, customer-target compatibility or business equivalence.
Release notes describe software changes, not proof of a successful conversion.
